view.name: Subscriptions feed
view.description: RSS subscription feed with channel avatar strip and a grid of feed item cards showing queue status.

regions.label: Narrow icon rail: VidBee logo, Home / Subscribe (active, amber) / Tools, Preferences and About pinned to bottom
Horizontal row of 'All' plus channel avatar buttons with status dots, and dashed 'Add subscription' button
4-column grid of video cards (thumbnail or 'No thumbnail' gradient, channel chip, date, Queued/Not queued pill, bold title), newest first

evidence.note: 80px navigation rail with icon+label destinations, active Subscribe item highlighted with amber tint; settings/info at bottom
Chronological stream of videos aggregated from subscribed channels, newest first, many items in a uniform grid
Rounded thumbnail (or grey 'No thumbnail' gradient placeholder) with channel chip overlay top-left, date bottom-left and status pill bottom-right; bold title below on page background

evidence.quote: 十年老笔记本还能干什么？

evidence.note: Clicking a channel avatar narrows the grid to that channel's videos immediately (verified live); 'All' is pressed by default
Single-select row of avatar buttons (aria-pressed), selected one gets grey rounded background
Green 'Queued' / black 'Not queued' status pill on each card
Green/red status dots on channel avatars (sync status, e.g. 'Up to date')
Hovering a channel avatar shows a white hover card below it: channel name, 'Up to date', 'Updated: 2026-11-17 22:18' (seen on live page, not in capture)
Hover content is a multi-line status card, coded as popover
Clicking a card did not open any detail view on the live page
An 'Automated Subscriptions with RSSHub' promo callout exists in the DOM below the captured area; it is informational, not a condition banner, and not visible in the capture

structure.layout: desktop app shell: fixed 80px left icon rail, main area with horizontal channel-avatar filter row on top and a 4-column card grid of videos scrolling inside the main panel

aesthetics.typography: Open Sans throughout: bold 16px card titles, 12px for chips/dates/status pills/nav labels, 14px controls
aesthetics.typeScale: Narrow scale: 16px bold titles vs 12px regular metadata; no large headings on this page

notes: Video cards are 316x178 rounded (18px) thumbnails; when no thumbnail exists a light-grey-to-dark gradient placeholder with centered 'No thumbnail' text is shown, so most of the grid is grey. Thumbnails that exist are generated-looking title cards (big bold text on colored gradient). Overlays: dark translucent pill with tiny channel avatar at top-left; white date bottom-left; fully rounded status pill bottom-right (emerald 'Queued' or near-black 'Not queued'). Channel filter row uses 48px colored-gradient initial avatars with green/red sync dots and truncated names; 'Add subscription' is a dashed-outline circle with plus, right-aligned. Active rail item is an amber RSS icon on pale-amber rounded square. Hover over channel avatar shows white status card. A cream 'Automated Subscriptions with RSSHub' callout with 'Open RSSHub Documentation' button sits at the end of the list but falls below the captured screenshot. Sonner toast region ('Notifications alt+T') present but empty.
